scripts.prepare: node -e "const c=require('node:child_process');if(c.spawnSync('git',['rev-parse','--is-inside-work-tree'],{stdio:'ignore'}).status===0)c.execFileSync('git',['config','core.hooksPath','.githooks'])" && node tools.mjs install && cargo install styling-lint --version 0.1.0 --locked && cargo install cargo-machete --version 0.9.2 --locked
scripts.check: concurrently --group "prettier --check ." "markdownlint-cli2 \"**/*.md\"" "jscpd ." "cargo fmt --check" "cargo check --all-targets && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings" "cargo machete" "styling-lint check"
